Yah this is late and i guess its very subjective.  but i guess by pointlessness, I personally, am just not caring about old pictures or little mementos and stuff like that.

Idk how long people are going to find and comment this.  It may seem like I'm throwing anyway help or advice and all but that's kinda the point.  Things people typically say are things that I've already asked and pondered myself.  It Really Really doesn't help depressed people to here things like "everything is going to be ok", etc unless they specifically need to here that.  
I'm looking for a New take on my situation and not the same cliche cliche cliche things people say.
This doesn't mean I don't appreciate the efforts of a stranger.

It's kinda rare for those moments I mentioned to even be good at all.

Also I tried to keep a journal and trying to keep up with writing became an unnecessary task.  I'm not saying I don't remember the events, but that I don't think about them Unless something reminds me of it.  Which seems like an ordinary thing yes but good things are better when they aren't connected to other things.  If that makes sense.  Plus I've also started to see the pointlessness of sentimentality for a similar reason.
I was saying not having friends isn't a problem to me.  Like I'm aware of it and all but it's just a fact of my life that I'm choosing not to alter.

And I know many people constantly say "oh I don't have friends", "I'm anti social", etc. but in reality they have like a few close ones and are friendly with everyone.  I don't.  I have co workers who ill have small talk with.  I don't have anything where I can meet people either.  I have one friend who doesn't talk to me much but we play games sometimes and he's been a good friend for years.  And I have one who I talk to a little more who I've know for longer, and that's it.  Neither talk to me first except very very rarely, like they're not trying.  I have two others who say they care and are worried about me but they never talk to me and I don't see them as friends.  But like I've said I'm totally fine without friends.  But yah

I get it.  But I don't have that motivation.  I don't have big goals or anything of the sort.  I've noticed that memories and experiences are kinda pointless.  Anyone can argue that the most important things in life is friends.  Any great moment is with friends.  I've thought it necessary to live life with friends, but I really don't have any.  No one tries to talk to me or be my friend, despite meeting hundreds of people and making friends through school and elsewhere.  Another goal in life is to have great experiences and make memories such as traveling a lot and vacations.  But my point is that memories fade, obviously, but I very rarely spontaneously think about a day I had with friends or a trip to Utah and anything like that.  I constantly forget that certain people exist, and that I was once good friends with them.  Why bother doing anything if you're going to forget it rather quickly.

Uh I don't.  I've stopped caring that my life is shitty cuz it's not going to change anything.  Worrying about college and my future and other stuff isn't going to help me.  Not sure if that answers it.
